description: Implementation of PersistentStreamPullingAgent class in Orleans.Streams namespace; manages pulling messages from queues, handling subscriptions, delivery, and error handling in a persistent streaming context.

classes.name: PersistentStreamPullingAgent
classes.description: Manages the pulling of messages from persistent queues for a specific stream provider, handles subscriber registration, message dispatching, error handling, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the queue cache, receiver, and timer for message polling; prepares the agent to start pulling messages.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully stops message pulling, disposes resources, and unregisters subscriptions.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Registers a new subscriber to the stream and initiates delivery if applicable.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the stream and stops message delivery for it.

methods.name: PumpQueue
methods.description: Main loop to fetch messages from the queue, handle retries, and process data.

methods.name: ReadFromQueue
methods.description: Fetches messages from the queue, updates cache, and manages stream registration.

methods.name: RunConsumerCursor
methods.description: Delivers messages to a consumer, manages cursor advancement, and handles delivery errors.
